walkthroughs.body_html:
Experimenting with Music — a core area of Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Experimenting with Music brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Experimenting with Music.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How does a harmonic minor scale differ from a natural minor?
options: All notes are raised by a semitone.
The seventh degree is raised by a semitone (creating a leading note).
Heavy use of electric guitars.
It has only five notes.

mcqs.q: What is characteristic of Baroque music?
options: Heavy use of electric guitars.
Continuous bass line, ornamentation, terraced dynamics, and counterpoint.
It has only five notes.
Simple melodies with piano accompaniment.
